notes: kb/Work PB5923 (closed by step 1 of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §1985:VI.3.3.4 GR1: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program." The source and object program half holds as before: BinderDriver.MakeUnit reads the PROGRAM-ID program-name as the unit's Name, the emitted class and ExternalizedName carry it, ProgramEmitter.EmitModuleRegistrar and HostEntryEmitter.EmitEntry register it, and a CALL finds the program by it (the AS literal-1 phrase of 2002 is refused at --std 85, COBOL0900). The listing half now holds: the compiler produces a listing at --std 85 (§1985:IV.7.1), ProgramRangeBuilder.Build gives every listing line the program that contains it, and every page heading (TextListingRenderer.IdentificationLine through PageComposer.Compose) names the program of the page's first line; each separately compiled program after the first starts a page.

next.reason: 1985: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program."; 2023: "Literal-1, if specified, is the name of the program that is externalized to the operating environment.". 2023 adds literal-1, so the externalized (object) name can differ from program-name-1. It also drops the statement that program-name identifies the listings.
